SPY.text: SPY slipped about 0.2% as weakness in mega-cap technology and semiconductors—especially Alphabet and AMD—slightly outweighed healthcare and consumer earnings gains; lower Treasury yields and optimism around Iran talks limited the decline.

QQQ.text: QQQ fell about 0.9% as AMD slid 7%, Alphabet fell roughly 4%, and semiconductor shares declined after investors reacted negatively to AI-spending and earnings details; lower Treasury yields were not enough to offset the technology selloff.
